items.title: Philip R. Lane: Diversity at the European Central Bank
Live updates: Bitcoin ETFs take $731 million, their biggest day since January
items.summary: Every fund in the complex rose almost 6% on Thursday and net assets crossed $103 billion for the first time. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for well over half the money.

items.title: OpenAI puts $1 billion behind cyber defense after unveiling AI that can find zero-days
items.summary: The company is subsidizing access to its Daybreak security platform after saying Astra can independently find previously unknown software flaws and turn them into working attacks.

items.title: One full bitcoin now buys a little more than 18 ounces of gold, the most since January
items.summary: Bitcoin is pulling ahead of gold even as both hard assets rally together, driven by fears that governments will inflate away their debt rather than by bond yields.

items.title: Bitcoin back above $81,000 as hike odds fade, Zcash leads with 15% jump
items.summary: Every major token gained on Friday as traders cut bets on a September Federal Reserve rate increase to a coin flip, though most of the majors are barely changed on the week.

items.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
items.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted a provisional charter to the new full-service bank, adding it to the growing mix of crypto-native institutions.
